security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU RISC-V CPU reports U-mode as supported (misas.RVU=1) but menvcfg CSR access raises illegal-instruction exception — either because the CSR table entry is missing, the access predicate chains to a gate other than U-mode presence, or the menvcfg internal state variable is uninitialized/NULL.
security_spec.summary: Spec now mandates menvcfg must exist whenever U-mode is present; QEMU must ensure the static CSR table entry and umode predicate correctly couple menvcfg existence to RVU, otherwise guest OS loses all menvcfg-controlled security features (CDE, STCE, FIOM, PBMTE, SSE, DTE, etc.) through silent register absence rather than WARL read-only-zero fallback.
